Simplified Chinese, crisp natural-size controls, flat white/#f7f8fa, dark #272b3a/secondary#657084, thin #e6e9f1 lines, primary#4566c6,8px radii and restrained shadow. PILOT input is STYLE ONLY, no importing its rail/header/tree/content. Actual source templates determine all titles, field order, controls, permissions and selected state. No protocol requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, fabricated success/online states, team/AI/ToDoo features or OS/browser-dialog chrome. Secret data empty or masked only. One coherent selected condition; hidden alternatives remain hidden. Preserve header/close/body-scroll/footer actions and actual disabled guards; do not derive new disabled rules from API constraints.
SOURCE-DERIVED TRASH FILE PERMANENT REMOVAL STRONG CONFIRMATION, local Ant Modal only. Title 永久移除回收站文件, enabledcloseX. Source mask closing is disabled even idle; no backdrop-dismiss UI action. Then exact paragraph 历史版本、备份及必要的元数据仍按各自保留规则保存。当前知识库中的正常笔记不会被移除。
Actual label 输入“永久移除”确认本次所选文件 and text input VALUE 永久移除 (already typed valid phrase), focused. No error since phrase valid, busy=false/pendingfalse. Footer actual取消 and danger-outlined 永久移除这 2 个文件, enabled. Exact handler validates trim phrase; source submit button itself disables onlybusy, no invented alternative invalid gating. No checkbox/backup deletion/entire-folder purge/active-library deletion, no snapshotId/fingerprint/requestId/hash fields, no undo promise, no completed purge summary or error simultaneously. Owner-scoped snapshot/time guards remain invisible. These frozen paths/count are isolated synthetic confirmation data only. Complete window, scroll affected list when necessary, actions reachable.
